component.name: LDWP Collective
component.summary: The official desktop application for the LDWP Collective

description.p: LDWP Collective for Desktop opens the LDWP Collective website in its own window, with persistent sign-in, a built-in download manager and keyboard shortcuts.
This is the Linux edition, built with GTK 4 and WebKitGTK.
First Linux release (GTK 4 / WebKitGTK, distributed as a Flatpak).
